title: Particle size distributions of wildfire aerosols in the western USA
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,502-516
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00007F, Paper

Siying Lu, Chiranjivi Bhattarai, Vera Samburova, Andrey Khlystov
Wildfires are a major source of aerosols during summer in the western United States. Wildfire aerosols tend to be significantly larger than non-fire ambient aerosols.
